_comment: Giovanni project settings template. /giovanni:init (scripts/init-fork.sh) copies this to .claude/settings.json. It carries what a plugin cannot: the permission layer of the external write gate (docs/governance.md § External write gate) and autoMemoryEnabled. The hooks themselves ship with the plugin (hooks/hooks.json) — do NOT add a hooks block here, or every hook runs twice. The hook and these globs are two independent layers on purpose; neither is load-bearing alone.

permissions._comment_deny: Channels demoted to absolute read-only. Empty by default: demotion is a decision your fork makes after a misfire, not a default. When you demote a channel, add its write globs here AND to readonly_channels in docs/governance.config.yaml (the hook reads that one). Example for a chat platform: mcp__*__chat_send*, mcp__*__chat_post*.
permissions._comment_ask: Write verbs on external connectors, plus the two local commands that reach outside the repo. Glob on verb, not on vendor — a new connector should land in the gate on the day it is added, not on the day someone remembers to list it.

_comment_automemory: Harness-side auto-memory writes to a per-machine path outside this repo. That splits memory between git and local disk — drift across devices and sessions. Memory lives in memory/, in git, always.
